candidate.title: scATAC-Seq (Microfluidics)
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina schematic of microfluidic single-cell ATAC-seq, interpreted as the C1/Integrated Fluidics Circuit implementation described by Buenrostro et al. The left Single cell / Single-cell assay for transposase accessible chromatin (scATAC-Seq) cartoon introduces the target; it is not a separate branch. The shaded Microfluidics device spans cell suspension, isolation, lysis/Tn5 introduction and the fragmented-and-primed chromatin illustration. A single route then shows cell-specific amplification and pooling. No alternative target workflow is depicted; the final visible material is pooled tagged DNA. The short colored tags and primer-like blue mark have no sequence or end-group legend; no strand polarity or exact tag chemistry is assigned from color. The sole amplification block is retained as drawn, with its on/off-device interpretation clarified in correction c_amplification_boundary.

method_scopes.rationale: The card names microfluidic scATAC-seq and explicitly associates it with Buenrostro et al. The inspected primary text describes single-cell capture on the C1 platform, transposition, cell-identifying PCR, pooling and sequencing, resolving this diagram's implementation within the wider scATAC-seq family. All five depicted operations apply to this microfluidic implementation. The broad amplification operation includes the primary paper's on-IFC and post-collection PCR distinction without adding unshown local operation nodes. This does not assert identical preparation for every scATAC-seq implementation.

checks.rationale: Independent inspection supports the complete schematic-level extraction. All five depicted transformations and all ten material connections are represented, with six mutually compatible states. The left assay cartoon is introductory and introduces no alternative route; no independent branches have been collapsed. Physical cell separation persists until sequence indexing, and pooling mixes indexed DNA libraries. Genomic fragments carry the accessibility readout, with enrichment and sparse sampling correctly qualified. The amplification-boundary discrepancy is explicitly resolved using the matched primary implementation while retaining the drawing. Every listed reference and the sole target method have an appropriate paper assessment. No consequential unsupported assertion, omitted depicted transformation, or architecture-changing unresolved question remains.

evidence.locator: b00006, Main: library composition and accessible-region enrichment
evidence.quote: Data from single cells recapitulate several characteristics of bulk ATAC-seq data, including fragment size periodicity corresponding to integer multiples of nucleosomes, and a strong enrichment of fragments within regions of accessible chromatin (Extended Data Fig. 2b,c).

evidence.locator: b00007, Main: incomplete single-cell representation
evidence.quote: The sparse nature of scATAC-seq data makes analysis of cellular variation at individual regulatory elements impractical.

checks.rationale: The assigned card heading and diagram identify one microfluidic scATAC-seq target. The primary C1/IFC implementation supports all five operation instances with their actual input histories, including the broad corrected amplification interface. Generic scATAC-seq wording in the introductory cartoon is not an additional alternative workflow. The two related publications and catalogue kit names do not expand the scope, and the candidate does not generalize this preparation to every scATAC-seq implementation.
